name: table_supported_stl_v1
description: Manual calibration pose derived from the current CAD STL meshes

approach.clockwise_viewpoint: operator side shown in the accepted setup photo

stl_constraints: The minimum world-Z vertex of link_2 arm_link.stl is tangent to the table plane defined by the minimum world-Z vertex of base_pair.stl.
The minimum world-Z vertex of the motor.stl carried by link_3 is tangent to the same table plane.
The motor carried by link_4 uses the upward-facing horizontal branch; its cylinder axis is vertical at joint_4=-0.0200523360 rad.
joint_6 is at the URDF lower hard limit (-1.57 rad), reached clockwise from the operator viewpoint.
notes: The positive mirrored solution matches the accepted setup: joint_2 moves counterclockwise about 100 degrees and keeps joint_4 inside its normal hard limit.
Do not command the robot to this pose; place it manually while all motors are in BRAKE mode and the arm is supported.
The clockwise endpoint is assigned to negative joint_6 by the agreed right-hand-rule convention; verify this once in the live mirror before enabling motion.
